text.p: Engineering, hardware and shipping group Howard Smith Ltd said on Wednesday that it still expects the group's full year results to be above last year's.
The company announced a 1995/96 full year net profit of A$86.13 million on August 27 and said it expected to improve its pre-abnormal profit in the year to June 30, 1997.
Chairman Frank Conroy told shareholders at the annual meeting that BBC Hardware group sales were up marginally in the first quarter, compared with the same quarter last year.
However, he said trade sales remained subdued with no evidence of a pick up in the domestic housing market.
Conroy said trading in the first quarter of industrial and engineering supplies distributor, Blackwoods, was ahead of the same period last year.
In the group's engineering division, Goninan was performing satisfactorily with a full order book and Conroy said he expected results for the year to be above last year.
For the marine division, he said Australian Towage activities had traded strongly in the first three months of the year.
